meta.description: Use when CrawClaw Android, iOS, or macOS companion apps cannot pair or connect through QR codes, setup codes, LAN, tailnet, public URL, bootstrap token, or auth routes.

copy.tagline: 解决 CrawClaw 应用无法配对连接的问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 CrawClaw 配套应用无法通过常规方式连接
copy.tagline_en: Fix pairing issues when CrawClaw apps cannot connect
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the CrawClaw companion app cannot pair or connect

howto.what: 当 CrawClaw 客户端无法配对或连接时，Claude 会分析配置和网络拓扑，找出问题根因并给出具体修复步骤。
howto.when: 当 CrawClaw 安卓、iOS 或 macOS 客户端无法通过二维码、设置码、局域网等方式配对或连接时触发。

say.text: CrawClaw 扫二维码没反应，帮我检查连接。
say.note: Claude 会查看配置并诊断路由问题。

say.text: 我的 CrawClaw 节点无法配对，显示未授权。
say.note: Claude 会检查令牌和认证模式。

say.text: CrawClaw 网关只绑在本地，远程连不上。
say.note: Claude 会建议修改绑定配置。

howto.what_en: When CrawClaw companion apps fail to pair or connect, Claude analyzes configuration and network topology to identify the root cause and provides a concrete fix route.
howto.when_en: Triggered when CrawClaw Android, iOS, or macOS apps cannot pair or connect via QR codes, setup codes, LAN, etc.

say_en.text: CrawClaw QR scan not working, check my connection.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect config and diagnose routing.

say_en.text: My CrawClaw node fails to pair, shows unauthorized.
say_en.note: Claude checks token and auth mode.

say_en.text: CrawClaw gateway is loopback-only, remote can't connect.
